ld_marco.summary: Marco is seeking $45,000 to consolidate credit card debt and fund minor home renovations, with a preferred 60-month term. Annual income around $95,000.
ld_marco.summaryTail: Call was conducted in Spanish (prospect's preference). Tone was warm and engaged; no objections raised. Recommended next step: specialist call with a Spanish-speaking rep to walk through qualifying products.

transcript.text: Hi, this is Ada calling from Northline Finance. Am I speaking with Marco Alvarez?
Yes, that's me.
Great — you just submitted a request on our site. Do you have two minutes to confirm a few details so we can route you to the right specialist?
Sure, go ahead.
Perfect. First — would you prefer to continue in English or Spanish?
Spanish would be ideal, but English is fine for this call.
Got it — I'll note Spanish as your preferred language so we can match you with a Spanish-speaking specialist. What amount are you looking to finance?
Around forty-five thousand dollars.
Forty-five thousand. And what's it for — consolidation, a vehicle, home improvements?
It's to consolidate some credit cards and do a few renovations at home.
Understood. What repayment term are you considering — 36, 48, or 60 months?
Sixty months would work best for me.
Perfect. One last question — what's your approximate annual income range?
Around ninety-five thousand a year.
Excellent, Marco. I have everything I need. A Spanish-speaking specialist will reach out to you in the next few minutes. Have a great day.
Thanks, you too.

ld_rebecca.summary: Rebecca is refinancing an existing auto loan of approximately $28,000 with ~2 years remaining. Current APR is high; she's looking to cut monthly payment.
ld_rebecca.summaryTail: Call was short and focused. She already has competing offers — recommend prioritizing contact within 24 hours.

transcript.text: Hi Rebecca, this is Ada from Northline. Is now a good time for a quick two-minute qualification?
Yeah, that's fine.
You mentioned auto refinance — what's the remaining balance on your current loan?
Around twenty-eight thousand, with about two years left.
And are you happy with your current payment, or looking to lower it?
Definitely looking to lower it. The APR is pretty rough.
Makes sense. What term length would you consider — 36 or 48 months?
Forty-eight works.
Got it. One last one — approximate annual income?
Seventy-eight thousand.
Perfect. I'll route you to a refinance specialist today. Thanks Rebecca.
Thanks.

ld_david.summary: David is financing a $62,000 home improvement project — kitchen remodel and roof replacement. Has existing mortgage, excellent credit per self-report.
ld_david.summaryTail: Prospect is comparison-shopping. Mentioned two competing quotes. Recommend lead with rate match rather than features.

transcript.text: Hi David, Ada from Northline. Do you have a moment to walk through your application?
Sure, go ahead.
You're looking at $62,000 for home improvement — can you tell me more?
Yeah, kitchen remodel and a new roof. Getting quotes now.
Understood. What term are you considering?
Sixty months, if the rate is right. I have a couple other offers.
Noted. Approximate annual income?
Around one forty-five.
Thanks. I'll put you in touch with a specialist who can quote competitively.
